forWhat: Where every bill you paid for the school goes, and where you see what became of it.
You file a claim, the operations lead of your campus approves it, and a founder pays it. Each step shows on your claim in words.

layout.shows: [[My claims]] for everyone and [[Rules]] to read how it works. [[To approve]] and [[To pay]] show only for the people who do that work, each with how many wait on them.
Your claims, newest first. Each card says who was paid, how much, when, and where it stands, and what happens next. Choose a card to see it whole, with the bill's picture.

The claim you chose, with what you can do to it: [[Withdraw]] while it waits, [[Add the bill]] if it has none, [[File it again]] when it was sent back. A person who keeps a campus store also sees [[Record what arrived]] on an approved or paid claim.

jobs.title: File a claim
steps: Take a photo of the bill, or choose the file. You may add it later.
Fill in the amount, the date, who was paid and what it was for. The page says in words beside any box that needs a fix.
Press [[File the claim]]. Your claim shows at the top with what happens next.

jobs.title: File a claim again after it was sent back
steps: Open the claim marked Sent back. It says why.
Press [[File it again]]. The form opens with the claim filled in.
Fix what was wrong, then press [[File the claim]].

jobs.title: Approve the claims of your campus
steps: Open [[To approve]]. The oldest claim waits first.
Look at the bill and the details.
Press [[Approve]], or press [[Send back]] and say why. The next claim opens by itself.

jobs.title: Pay an approved claim
steps: Pay the person outside the site. Then say when, how and the reference, and press [[Mark paid]].
The person sees their claim as paid, with the date and the reference.

jobs.title: Change the money rules
steps: Open [[Rules]]. Only the founders can change them; everyone else reads them.
Change a limit, a deadline or a category, and say why if you like.
Press [[Save the rules]]. A rule set that cannot work is refused, in words. A change reaches only claims filed after it.

buttons.label: New claim
buttons.does: Opens the form to file a claim.
buttons.doesNot: It files nothing until you press File the claim.

buttons.label: File the claim
buttons.does: Files the claim for your operations lead to see.

buttons.label: Withdraw
buttons.does: Takes your claim back while it still waits. It stays on your list as withdrawn.
buttons.doesNot: It does not delete the claim.

buttons.label: Approve
buttons.does: Says yes to the claim. It then waits for a founder to pay it.
buttons.doesNot: It does not pay the claim.

buttons.label: Send back
buttons.does: Returns the claim with your reason, so the person can file it again.
buttons.doesNot: It does not remove the claim.

buttons.label: Mark paid
buttons.does: Records that the claim was paid, with the date, the way and the reference.
buttons.doesNot: It does not move any money.

buttons.label: Save the rules
buttons.does: Keeps the rules you changed, for claims filed from now on.
buttons.doesNot: It does not change a claim already filed.
